## About
Beltway Discount Tires is a family-owned and operated tire shop on Eisenhower Avenue in Alexandria. We carry new, discount and used name-brand tires for cars and trucks, from brands like Michelin, Dunlop, Bridgestone, Uniroyal, Goodyear, Continental and Cooper. We also sell trailer tires and new wheels and rims.
Tires are only part of it. We fix flats and handle mounting, balancing, alignments, brakes, shocks and struts, oil changes and tune-ups. Drivers come to us from Fairfax, Arlington, Woodbridge, Maryland and Washington DC.
We're rated 4.3 from 277 Google reviews. Stop by Monday through Saturday or give us a call.

## Services
- New name-brand tires: Car and truck tires from Michelin, Dunlop, Bridgestone, Uniroyal and other name brands.
- Used tires: Used tires in all name brands at half the price of new.
- Trailer tires: Tires for your trailer, too.
- Flat repair: Bring in a flat and we'll take care of it, along with mounting and balancing.
- Alignments: Alignment service for your car or truck.
- Alignment check: No purchase necessary.
- Brake check: No purchase necessary.
- Brake pad install: Labor only. ($99.00)
- Oil changes: Call to schedule your next oil change. (Starting at $39.95)
- Tire rotation: Price shown is for small cars. ($30.00)
- New wheels: Wheels from brands including Asanti, BBS, Cragar, Mossa and Pacer. (Starting at $150.00)
- Shocks, struts and tune-ups: General auto service alongside your tires.
- Repair estimates: Detailed, fair and accurate, with no obligation.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Saturday 8:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. We're closed Sunday.

Q: Do you have tires for trucks?
A: Yes. We carry used and discount tires for both trucks and cars.

Q: Is there a deal for mentioning your website?
A: Mention our website and get 10% off any of our automotive services. It applies to labor only and doesn't include tires.

Q: Do I need an appointment for an oil change?
A: Give us a call to schedule your next oil change.
